mapper.sql: u.user_id, u.user_type_cd, t.code_nm AS user_type_nm, u.login_id, u.user_nm, u.email, u.mobile_no, u.company_id, c.company_nm, u.status_cd, st.code_nm AS status_nm, u.join_dt

LEFT JOIN tb_company c ON c.company_id = u.company_id LEFT JOIN tb_code t ON t.group_cd = 'USER_TYPE' AND t.code = u.user_type_cd LEFT JOIN tb_code st ON st.group_cd = 'USER_STATUS' AND st.code = u.status_cd
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM tb_user u LEFT JOIN tb_company c ON c.company_id = u.company_id

SELECT , u.birth_date, u.dept_nm, u.position_nm, CASE WHEN u.reg_id IS NULL THEN 'USER_SERVICE' ELSE 'ADMIN' END AS join_path, u.pwd_temp_yn, u.last_login_dt, u.withdraw_dt, ra.admin_nm AS reg_nm, u.reg_dt, ma.admin_nm AS mod_nm, u.mod_dt FROM tb_user u LEFT JOIN tb_admin ra ON ra.admin_id = u.reg_id LEFT JOIN tb_admin ma ON ma.admin_id = u.mod_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND u.del_yn = 'N'
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_user WHERE login_id = #{loginId})
SELECT status_cd FROM tb_company WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND del_yn = 'N'

INSERT INTO tb_user (login_id, password, pwd_temp_yn, user_type_cd, company_id, user_nm, email, mobile_no, birth_date, dept_nm, position_nm, status_cd, join_dt, reg_id, mod_id) VALUES (#{loginId}, #{password}, 'Y', #{userTypeCd}, #{v.companyId}, #{v.userNm}, #{v.email}, #{v.mobileNo}, #{v.birthDate}, #{v.deptNm}, #{v.positionNm}, 'ACTIVE', now(), #{regId}, #{regId}) RETURNING user_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_user SET user_nm = #{v.userNm}, email = #{v.email}, mobile_no = #{v.mobileNo}, birth_date = #{v.birthDate}, company_id = #{v.companyId}, dept_nm = #{v.deptNm}, position_nm = #{v.positionNm}, mod_id = #{modId}, mod_dt = now() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_yn = 'N' AND date_trunc('second', mod_dt) = date_trunc('second', #{modDt}::timestamp)

UPDATE tb_user SET status_cd = #{statusCd}, withdraw_dt = now(), mod_id = #{modId}, mod_dt = now() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_yn = 'N' AND date_trunc('second', mod_dt) = date_trunc('second', #{modDt}::timestamp)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_user_status_hist (user_id, before_status_cd, after_status_cd, reason, reg_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{beforeStatusCd}, #{afterStatusCd}, #{reason}, #{regId})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_user SET password = #{password}, pwd_temp_yn = 'Y', mod_id = #{modId}, mod_dt = now() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE tb_user SET del_yn = 'Y', mod_id = #{modId}, mod_dt = now() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT h.reg_dt, h.before_status_cd, b.code_nm AS before_status_nm, h.after_status_cd, a.code_nm AS after_status_nm, h.reason, ad.admin_nm AS reg_nm FROM tb_user_status_hist h LEFT JOIN tb_code b ON b.group_cd = 'USER_STATUS' AND b.code = h.before_status_cd LEFT JOIN tb_code a ON a.group_cd = 'USER_STATUS' AND a.code = h.after_status_cd LEFT JOIN tb_admin ad ON ad.admin_id = h.reg_id WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY h.reg_dt DESC, h.hist_id DESC
SELECT code_nm FROM tb_code WHERE group_cd = 'PRIVACY_REASON' AND code = #{reasonCd} AND use_yn = 'Y'
